PR #74 opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/74

Summary of what was done:

**Both PR #72 defects fixed at the root, not reworded:**
1. **Unverifiable citation** — every Owner quote in the amended phase_2/phase_5 text now cites `/opt/veridian/ai-os/OWNER_DIRECTIVES/BROWSER_NATIVE_END_USER_ARCHITECTURE_2026-07-25.txt` by exact path (the real verbatim directive), never the `OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED` paraphrase. Every quote was `grep -F` verified byte-for-byte present in that file before being written.
2. **Mandatory-AI misread** — re-derived phase_5 from scratch: Gateway G05 stays its existing Tier-5 escalation-only role; Stage 2 is deterministic server-side SOFTWARE execution per the source file's own interpretive note. Both phase_2 and phase_5 now explicitly reconcile this against `registries.credit_spend_governance`'s real propose/report two-gate rule in `ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml`.

Along the way I caught and fixed two of my own bugs before committing: a YAML syntax break (unquoted scalars containing `#72`, which YAML parses as a comment start) and a citation-accuracy slip (I'd initially misquoted the credit-governance phrase as "...when genuinely needed" instead of the real "...when needed"). Phases 1/3/4/6-10 and phase_1's dispatch state were left untouched, confirmed via review that no changes were needed there.
